text:
Ava (AE): Heads-up 1: Prospect (Vermilion Health) wants Dedicated POC. They returned MSA with DPA redlines demanding KMS attestation, SOC2 proof, and Net60 on PO. Also said DocuSign traffic is blocked. Need quick path to sign + start infra.

Noah (Legal): Paste their DPA sentence if you have it. Short answer: we can add a KMS addendum promising attestation limited to their tenant keys within 7 business days. For signature fallback: we can accept signed PDF uploaded to our secure portal + email mirror; that'll satisfy audit.

Ava (AE): Redline: "Vendor shall provide KMS attestation and allow Customer audit access to key metadata prior to production access."

Noah (Legal): Proposed tweak: "Vendor will provide a signed KMS/HSM attestation limited to cryptographic material used by Customer within 7 business days of written request. On-prem inspection requires separate SOW." I'll draft and post.

Leah (Finance): Net60 is higher risk. If PO < $20k we do Net30. For Net60 need CFO approval and either a $20k refundable hold or milestone billing (50% upfront). Also invoice must include PO number and remit instructions.

Omar (Infra): Attestation note: we can produce an HSM attestation in ~3 business days if scope is limited. On-prem or full key inspection is multi-week. DocuSign: if their gateway blocks us, two options: they whitelist our signing IP temporarily or we accept portal upload. Portal preserves hash/audit.

upload-bot: Doc uploaded: https://secure.docs/redwood/vermilion/msaredline_v2.pdf 1 checklist: [KMS addendum draft] [Finance Net terms] [Signature method confirmed] [SOC2 link sent]

Ava (AE): I'll ask procurement if Net60 is mandatory or negotiable and request IP whitelist for signing. Noah: please drop the addendum in the doc link when ready. Leah: PO estimate ~16k.

Noah (Legal): Will draft addendum today with 7 business day attestation + portal signature clause.

Leah (Finance): PO 16k => Net30 ok. Escalate to me if they insist on Net60 and I'll route to CFO.

Ava (AE): Great, thanks team :thumbsup:
